d:
United Tigers roared to a convincing 19-run victory over Royal Desert Champions in the 16th match of the Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026!
Batting first, United Tigers posted a formidable total, powered by Joe Clarke’s explosive 77 off just 26 balls, helping them register the second-highest total in league history.
In reply, Royal Desert Champions fell short as United Tigers held their nerve to seal a 19-run victory, with Clarke earning the Player of the Match honours!
Watch 2026 | 7th NOV to 20th NOV on Star Sports & JioHotstar.
